verdict.rationale: The docs say `tofu plan` creates an execution plan that previews the changes OpenTofu will make. Speculative plans let users check the effect of changes before review, a destroy mode plans destruction, and `-out=FILE` saves the plan so `tofu apply` executes exactly what was previewed. The core plan-before-apply workflow is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the plan output breaks changes down per resource into creates, updates and destroys, and independent hands-on corroboration of plan accuracy.
